metadata.query: What does it mean to decimate an army?

reasoning_steps.observation:
--- Retrieved Document 1 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.671) ---
Title: Information on: What does it mean to decimate an army?...
Decimation of an army refers to the ancient Roman military practice whereby every tenth soldier in a unit was selected at random and executed as a form of severe discipline for collective disobedience or cowardice during battle. This punishment was intended to serve as a deterrent against further misconduct within the ranks.
--- End Document 1 ---
